cases.name: testSpaceBeforeComma
cases.src:
define view C_AnyView
  with parameters
    P_AnyParam  : any_type    ,
    P_OtherParam:other_type

  as select from I_AnyView(
    P_AnyParam  ::P_AnyParam ,
    P_OtherParam: :P_OtherParam ) as AnyAlias

{
  key AnyKeyField   ,
  key OtherKeyField ,

      AnyValue*2 +OtherValue* 4- ThirdValue as AnyValueField,
      3*(-2*AnyValue- 4*OtherValue) as OtherValueField,

      concat(AnyText,concat('_' ,OtherText)) as AnyTextField,
      division(AnyArg *10,OtherArg,2) as ThirdValue,
      round(AnyValue* 100, 5) as RoundedValue,

      cast(AnyAmount   as abap.curr(23 ,2)) as AnyAmount  ,
      cast(OtherAmount as abap.curr(23,2)) as OtherAmount ,
      cast(AnyQuantity as abap.quan(18, 6)) as AnyQuantity,
}
cases.exp:
define view C_AnyView
  with parameters
    P_AnyParam  : any_type    ,
    P_OtherParam: other_type

  as select from I_AnyView(
    P_AnyParam  : :P_AnyParam ,
    P_OtherParam: :P_OtherParam ) as AnyAlias

{
  key AnyKeyField   ,
  key OtherKeyField ,

      AnyValue * 2 + OtherValue * 4 - ThirdValue as AnyValueField ,
      3 * (-2 * AnyValue - 4 * OtherValue) as OtherValueField ,

      concat(AnyText , concat('_' , OtherText)) as AnyTextField ,
      division(AnyArg * 10 , OtherArg , 2) as ThirdValue ,
      round(AnyValue * 100 , 5) as RoundedValue ,

      cast(AnyAmount   as abap.curr(23 ,2)) as AnyAmount  ,
      cast(OtherAmount as abap.curr(23 ,2)) as OtherAmount ,
      cast(AnyQuantity as abap.quan(18 ,6)) as AnyQuantity ,
}

cases.name: testSpecialCasesOfAsterisk
cases.src:
define view C_AnyView
  as select from I_AnyView as AnyAlias

  association [1..*] to I_OtherView as _OtherAlias
    on AnyAlias.AnyKeyField = _OtherAlias.AnyKeyField

  composition [0..*] of I_ThirdView as _ThirdAlias

{
  key AnyAlias.AnyKeyField,
      count(*) as AnyCount,
      count( * ) as OtherCount,
      _OtherAlias[*: AnyField = 1].OtherField as OtherField
}
group by AnyAlias.AnyKeyField

cases.name: testIdentifiersWithNamespaces
cases.src:
define view entity /ANY/I_AnyView
  with parameters
    P_Any : /ANY/any_type

  as select from /ANY/I_OtherView as /ANY/A/l/i/a/s/

  association to /ANY/I_ThirdView as  _/Other/Alias
  on _/Other/Alias.AnyID = /ANY/A/l/i/a/s/.AnyID

{
  key  /ANY/A/l/i/a/s/./ANY/Field/ as /ANY/Field/,

      2/ $parameters.P_Any as /ANY/OtherField,
      1+10* /ANY/A/l/i/a/s/./ANY/ThirdField / 2 as /ANY/ThirdField,
      1 + 10 * /ANY/FourthField / 2 as /ANY/FourthField/,
      1+_/Other/Alias./ANY/FifthField/ as /ANY/FifthField/,
      _/Other/Alias
}
cases.exp:
define view entity /ANY/I_AnyView
  with parameters
    P_Any : /ANY/any_type

  as select from /ANY/I_OtherView as /ANY/A/l/i/a/s/

  association to /ANY/I_ThirdView as  _/Other/Alias
  on _/Other/Alias.AnyID = /ANY/A/l/i/a/s/.AnyID

{
  key  /ANY/A/l/i/a/s/./ANY/Field/ as /ANY/Field/,

      2 / $parameters.P_Any as /ANY/OtherField,
      1 + 10 * /ANY/A/l/i/a/s/./ANY/ThirdField / 2 as /ANY/ThirdField,
      1 + 10 * /ANY/FourthField / 2 as /ANY/FourthField/,
      1 + _/Other/Alias./ANY/FifthField/ as /ANY/FifthField/,
      _/Other/Alias
}
